annotations.title: S&P 500 Stock Picks with Thesis: daily ranked trend screen

description: [Kyreos, 0.008 USDC per call via x402 on Base] Daily stock picks with thesis: ranks up to 25 large caps (default SPY, QQQ, AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, AMZN, GOOGL, META, TSLA, JPM) on 5 trend rules (50/200-day averages, 3-month return, 52-week high) and writes one plain thesis sentence per symbol from measured closes. Mechanical, no LLM, no invented numbers. Data, not investment advice. Input: {"symbols":["AAPL","NVDA"]} or {} for the default 10. HTTP: GET https://store.agentexchange.work/w/sp500-thesis-screen?q=... Call once without x_payment to get the x402 payment terms (0.008 USDC); call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result.

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload for the terms returned on the first call (0.008 USDC on Base)
